records.title: When Efficiency Backfires: Cascading LLMs Trigger Cascade Failure under Adversarial Attack
records.reason: The paper experimentally studies adversarial vulnerabilities of cost-efficient cascaded LLM deployments and measures token costs under attacks/defenses. Its focus is robustness/security rather than reducing inference cost, but the cascade architecture and explicit cost analysis leave a plausible weak connection to LLM routing/serving lineages.

records.title: Transitivity Meets Cyclicity: Explicit Preference Decomposition for Dynamic Large Language Model Alignment
records.reason: This paper develops preference decomposition and dynamic alignment/post-training methods. Its full text evaluates alignment outcomes rather than inference resource use, latency, throughput, or serving.

records.title: X-SYNTH: Beyond Retrieval - Enterprise Context Synthesis from Observed Digital Human Attention
records.reason: X-SYNTH ranks and selects enterprise artifacts using behavioral attention and content relevance before agentic synthesis. The full text documents that direct inference over 120k–2.5M daily tokens is infeasible, so selective context retrieval may reduce input burden; however, it does not establish a concrete inference-system speed/memory result, and its linked MoE-VL connection is indirect.
